entries/add_targets.json::/pages/0/text: Adds extra targets for mobs to improve immersion
entries/alligator_snapping_turtle.json::: ASTs will go dormant during the day unless when raining or disturbed
ASTs propagate moss when in water or raining, bone-meal can be applied to AST's to increase moss
entries/bald_eagle.json::/pages/0/text: Bald Eagles while controlled can pickup explosives, allowing the user to drop it by pressing 'sneak' key
entries/banana_slug.json::/pages/0/text: Allows shearing of banana slugs for banana related items
entries/bone_serpent.json::/pages/0/text: Bone Serpent takes 1 damage while losing a body segment, the head takes normal damage once enough are destroyed
entries/bunfungus.json::/pages/0/text: Bunfungus during the day harvests nearby crops, healing a bit
entries/capuchin_monkey.json::/pages/0/t: Lace darts by monkeys with potion effects,by right clicking with a potion.Limited to the top effect of the given potion
entries/cave_centipede.json::/pages/0/te: Cave Centipedes flee from light held by players unless attacked (Compatible with Curios Lanterns)
entries/cockroach.json::/pages/0/text: Cockroaches can be given 'The Roach Crown', becoming the Roach King,nearby cockroaches also get turned into servants
entries/cockroach.json::/pages/1/text: Cockroach servants convert other roaches and attack those that harm the king
entries/cockroach.json::/pages/2/text: [MUST HAVE ALEXS CAVES PRESENT] Cockroach mutate to Gammaroach when exposed to radiation
entries/combust.json::/pages/0/text: Combustion occurs to oiled mobs Compatibility with Soul Fire
entries/cosmaw.json::/pages/0/text: Cosmaws gets weak when carrying heavily armored players, Cosmaws cannot carry players when weakened
entries/cosmaw.json::/pages/1/text: With the 'Lightweight' enchantment, found within the cities of the end. Cosmaws no longer get weak when carrying their owner
entries/crimson_mosquito.json::/pages/0/: 'Blooded' is inflicted from blood projectiles to liquid blood from 'Biomes Of Plenty'can be washed off with water
entries/crimson_mosquito.json::/pages/1/: Blooded can be targeted by Crimson Mosquitoes twice as far.Blooded slows,reduces armor and damage for those inflicted.
entries/devils_hole_pupfish.json::/pages: Added interactions and trades, allowing to fish up DHPs within its chunk and trade with fishermen
entries/egg_attack.json::/pages/0/text: Animals attack those seen holding their eggs
entries/elephant.json::/pages/0/text: Tusked elephants aggro towards players not holding Acacia Blossoms
entries/elephant.json::/pages/1/text: Ridden Elephants trample entities below 2 blocks
entries/emu.json::/pages/0/text: Emu attack enemies holding ranged weapons
entries/endergrade.json::/pages/0/text: Endergrade are immune to the void, including their riders
entries/endergrade.json::/pages/1/text: Endergrade can be boosted forward with a chorus fruit on a stick
entries/enderiophage.json::/pages/1/text: Enderiophage cannot infect mobs inflicted with Damage Resistance
entries/enderiophage.json::/pages/2/text: Enderiophage adapt to their dimension when created
entries/farseer.json::/pages/0/text: Farseer discombobulate targeted players, scrambling inventory and messing with the mind
entries/farseer.json::/pages/1/text: With the 'Stabilizer' enchantment, found within the remains of a massive worm. Mind altering effects are nullified, from farseers,elder guardians and watchers (IF ALEXS CAVES IS ENABLED)
entries/flutter.json::/pages/0/text: Flutters can be sheared for azalea, moss and spore blossoms
entries/fly.json::/pages/0/text: Flies get attracted to certain animals and get repelled by candles
entries/fly.json::/pages/2/text: Casting a fishing rod with a maggot in hand increases fishing luck
entries/flying_fish.json::/pages/0/text: Flying Fish Boots's mechanics changed to be more fluid and based on speed and look angle
entries/food_fx.json::/pages/0/text: Animals eating dropped food will inherit the food's effects
entries/frilled_shark.json::/pages/0/tex: Frilled Shark attack players with exsanguination or low health
entries/grizzly_bear.json::/pages/0/text: If they haven't had honey in a while, Grizzlies may break containers containing food
entries/grizzly_bear.json::/pages/1/text: If enabled for the grizzly bear, it will hunt for animals as well
entries/grizzly_bear.json::/pages/2/text: Grizzlies can be brushed for their hair
entries/guster.json::/pages/0/text: Gusters ability to lift players is determined by their armor value
entries/guster.json::/pages/1/text: Introduces a new effect, 'Gusting'. It allows mobs to resist gusters and gusts lifting,increasing movement speed, and players spawn gusts around them
entries/kangaroo.json::/pages/0/text: Allows kangaroos to be equipped with totems, also fixes non breakable weapons to break when equipped
entries/laviathan.json::/pages/0/text: Obsidian can be extracted from laviathans when solidified,causing them to take small damage and needing to reheat
entries/leafcutter_ant.json::/pages/0/te: Leafcutter chambers with high levels of fungus may contain cockroaches when destroyed
entries/leafcutter_ant.json::/pages/1/te: Leafcutter pupi can be thrown as a projectile and spawns anthills when landing on appropriate terrain
entries/leafcutter_ant.json::/pages/2/te: Ant variants appear, causing rivalry between ant colonies
entries/mimicube.json::/pages/0/text: Mimicubes mimic their targeted players speech
entries/mob_transformation.json::/pages/:
Transform mobs into different mobs by splashing weakness and feeding their respective items 
Rainfrog/Frog + Warped Fungus = Warped Toad 
Fly + Blood Sac = Crimson Mosquito 
Crimson Mosquito + Warped Muscle = Warped Mosco
entries/murmur.json::/pages/0/text: Murmur's body and head are seperate and its head will regrow until the body is dead
entries/murmur.json::/pages/1/text: With the new enchantment 'Stretchy Accumulation' found within the abandoned railwaysTendon Whips can grab items and xp for its user when launched
entries/murmur.json::/pages/2/text: Wearing a unsettling kimono will cause iron golems and snow golems to attack you
entries/orca.json::/pages/0/text: Orca's Might give neutrality towards skelewags
entries/potoo.json::/pages/0/text: Potoo when held with falcon glove, give night vision to its holder
entries/rainfrog.json::/pages/0/text: Rain frog burrow away when hurt
entries/rocky_roller.json::/pages/0/text: With the enchantment 'Rolling Thunder', found within underground mineshafts. You're able to roll through liquids
entries/seagull.json::/pages/0/text: Seagulls will avoid snatching when low on health, or when player has sombrero
entries/seagull.json::/pages/1/text: Seagulls will only snatch food from hands
entries/skreecher.json::/pages/0/text: Skreecher Souls can be applied to sculk shriekers to allow them to spawn wardens
entries/skreecher.json::/pages/1/text: A new effect made from skreecher souls, that spawns a warden when the effect ends naturally
entries/snow_leopard.json::/pages/0/text: Snow Leopards causes slain mobs to drop their loot table 1-2 times
entries/snow_leopard.json::/pages/1/text: Snow Leopard will hunt weakened moose, and also attack players with moose headgear
entries/soul_vulture.json::/pages/0/text: Soul Vultures no matter what, when attacking a mob will cause its soul level to go up
entries/straddler.json::/pages/0/text: Straddler can shoot a number of times before needing to reload, (default:8)
entries/straddler.json::/pages/1/text: Straddleboards drop half of its material costs if it doesnt drop itself
entries/sunbird.json::/pages/0/text: Provides additional effects, blessings burn and weaken nearby undead,curses buffs nearby undead
entries/tamed_friendlies.json::/pages/0/: Some tamable animals from AM are passive when tamed
entries/terrapin.json::/pages/0/text: Terrapin takes damage when stepped on
entries/tusklin.json::/pages/0/text: Tusklin can be turned to zoglins with lightning
entries/vanilla_mobs.json::/pages/0/text: Witches imploy the use of poison resistance when poisoned
entries/void_worm.json::/pages/0/text: Dimensional Carver with a lodestone compass offhand,can carve a portal to the lodestone at the cost of the compass
